meta.author: Daniel Weber
meta.title: From tools to systems
meta.subtitle: Why connecting tools is more powerful than adding new ones

content.text: Modern teams use more tools than ever before.
Each tool solves a specific problem — communication, data, project management. But as the number of tools grows, so does the complexity of managing them.
The real challenge isn't choosing the right tools.
Without integration, tools create silos. Information gets fragmented. Workflows become disconnected.
What teams need isn't more tools.
bigA.i acts as the layer that connects everything — turning isolated tools into a unified workflow where data flows seamlessly and processes run automatically.
